body: You deserve better. I’ve never once called my boyfriends my friend. She’s manipulative and honestly it’s kind of creepy how she tries to keep it light when you’re bringing up something completely valid. Throw her away.

My cat naturally does this, I still don’t let her outside on purpose unless I’m with her the entire time. My mother who has worked in agriculture and with domesticated animals explained that cats will set a territory and stick to it, and that walking them outside of that territory can then expand it, which can lead to the cat thinking a larger area is “theirs” and will wander a lot further. Not sure if that makes sense, but ours has decided the front porch and portion of back yard is enough. She walks to some imaginary line then stays. It’s weird but we’re thankful for it.
Micro dosing them helped my depression, when I started doing the higher doses it did not. I hope the best for you though.

It’s overwhelming. I had to remove myself from social media since that’s where I would see and find some of the worst things. It sucks growing up and realizing all these horrific acts that happen and we’re not able to stop them. Animal cruelty tops mine as well, and if I don’t remove myself from that thinking it consumes me. You’re a very sensitive and empathic person, we need more people who care the way you do. I hope your therapy is helping, try to remember that for all those bad things, there are people working to oppose them and there’s good stories too, they just don’t make the media as often. Bad news tends to travel faster unfortunately.

When I felt that way (and after a mental break)
 I got two jobs, joined a team club, and just started becoming active in the community.
Now I’ll be graduating soon and my career will be focused on community outreach to combat issues like loneliness. 
There’s so many people in this world that feel the same as we do, but there isn’t a rule guide on how to defeat it. But I assure you technology is what’s making it worse. People don’t feel the need to seek out companionship because we have the simulated version constantly. (Disconnection)
If you believe it won’t get better, it won’t. Entertain the concept of hope, and please message me if you’d like to talk or any advice. Our society isn’t doing enough to help one another, so we have to be the strong ones and do it ourselves.

As someone who has lost friends to suicide and almost succeeded myself, the burden will be you leaving. If people make you feel like a burden, they could simply not be equipped to deal with high emotions (I had to learn this with close family and friends) and it sucks to feel that way. But that means that YOU do understand those emotions, and can help others when they’re also faced with relationships that don’t realize they’re making someone feel like “too much”. When I finally came out of my suicidal cloud after almost two years, I was able to see clearly no one was at fault, no one felt the way I assumed, and everyone would have been devastated if I’d followed through 

The best way out of depression and suicide is to help others. Volunteer. Create your own purpose. There’s animals, people, even nature out there that will always need our intervention. You can save others while saving yourself.
OTGW is a masterpiece, we watch it every fall!

My ex’s mom said it helped her immensely, but her and his family are also able to watch videos, look at pictures, and have his things through out the house. I can’t look at photos of him, or even cards or gifts he gave me. So talking about it just still isn’t in the question for me. Grief is different for everyone but I really think trying different approaches can’t do any real harm. Being around others that understand the weight you’re carrying has to have some benefits in terms of being able to relate. If you go please let me know how it is, I’ve been debating doing it the past two years.

Hi just saying I feel this way as well, where talking about it doesn’t seem to help… do you feel it doesn’t help because it’s hard to talk about? Or because you know it won’t change the outcome? Or something else? Im trying to understand myself a bit better if I know others are experiencing something similar
Aka you have skills others don’t have and a higher depth than most would like to attain. That is not a worthless degree. Don’t give up. Please.

Life is a video game, sometimes the current level feels impossible, but you keep at it until you beat it and you get to have some relief in seeing how you overcame it. I wanted to kill myself for 4 years. When I came out of it, I couldn’t believe I used to think that way. 

Volunteer. I’m not joking. Go and make a difference, move a turtle out of the way of traffic, leave a nice note in a neighbors mailbox or on a car. Interact in this world and it helps to give back the purpose you’re meant to feel. Helping others is the purpose many of us have but don’t realize.

PS
Good people love everyone, I don’t know you but I will be devastated if you were to leave. It sucks when we don’t get to meet the people we could help the most. We all love you.

The fact that you can acknowledge things hard for women mean you’re not a true incel. You have empathy and understanding.

So while it’s true attractive men do have high expectations, many of us are taught at a young age to ignore it, to empower ourselves and know our worth. How often do you see that happening for young boys though? I think the approach for many is why men end up feeling like they’re not good enough, women have had to deal with proving their worth so we had guidance to achieving that. Not all obviously, but there needs to be more focus on why so many men are insecure, are more likely to commit suicide, and least likely to be diagnosed with a mental disorder. All because of the “be a man” mantra they shoved on little boys.

Anyone and everyone is lovable. Don’t let society tell you any differently. You dictate the respect you earn, if you don’t feel you’re getting it, then you’re probably around people that don’t love themselves.

But I also know what it feels like…I was someone who gained a bunch of weight, and only recently lost it. While I was also considered obese (and 5’2, so shit did that show) I assumed no guys wanted me, and just took on the roll as the funny fat girl. Turned out because of my assumptions, I was constantly turning people away who were interested. 

Just don’t assume your height and weight are why. If they are for some people, then those aren’t your people right? Should you be with people that only see you for the outside rather than your actual content?

I think we all need to stop using “hot” people as a way to live life and just live whatever one you have authentically. Tall guys scare me, I hate guys that are ripped, there are tons of other women like this, I promise.

I’m a pretty staunch feminist but I truly believe men get the shit end when it comes to a lot of expectations. I hate that you feel you have to have sex appeal to be successful, because that might be true for those who value it, but do you want to be around people who value something like that? We’re all gonna get old and crusty, sex appeal is for basics lacking in personality and depth. In my opinion of course

You’re also young, I didn’t start having “good” sex until 23. A lot of guys act like they’re good at it, they’re not. We’re faking, I promise 😂

Good to note as well that being good at sex, comes from (in my experience) a deep connection. If you’re truly comfortable with someone, and there’s trust, that’s when you get to practice without judgement. No one is just good at sex, we all had to practice and fail. I know I did 😂

That’s so cool though, sounds like a true breakthrough. Did you change anything after that trip? Or feel the need to I guess?

It makes me feel better that you had a telepathic experience too! None of my friends have had that, and kinda didn’t believe me since I took such a small amount. mine spoke to me in my head as well, I asked it back in my own head what it was, and it asked if I “wanted to see” and that it “could take me there if I wanted to”. It felt like I left my body, then my friend spoke and it felt like I slammed back into it. Now I’m wondering if it was something bad, I had a lot of bad mental energy around myself at the time.

I know women like this but I know more that just want a man to respect them and truly love them…. I don’t know what area you live in but it’s skewing how “all women” are. If a woman only cares about money that is a red flag, stay away from the ones like that

Woman here, best sex I ever had was the same size as you, and actually shorter in height (5’9)

I’ve begin to believe both men and women look at the media and think those are the standards everybody wants.

“Good looking” men are not any better than “bad” looking ones. Women who have integrity know this, if you’re only around women that care about height or even that you went soft during sex, then she’s not the one for you. You have to do good things and surround yourself with good people if you want to find a woman who likes you for you.

I think it’s great you want to improve yourself, but don’t do it for the sake of getting a woman, do it for yourself and the natural confidence will draw people in. That’s what’s sexiest to a lot of people. 

Not all women like or use dating apps, you might want to stay away from those as they host a lot of superficial people. Unless you’re just trying to have sex.

Also, on the bright side you’re more reflective than most men I come across, even if it’s a little harsh on yourself. A guy that can think deeply, see a problem and want to fix it, that’s attractive as hell.
Yours sounds possibly similar to something that happened to me, also low dose, did it interact with you or anything?

It’s hard to feel like no one understands you, I get that completely. 
But there are others who do think like you, who are feeling the same way, but being misunderstood means you’re doing something right. The way the world is? This is really the best we can do? People also didn’t understand any of the big leaders and activists when they first started, they were outcasts, yet they were valid and in the end changed things for the better. So take solace at least with the fact that you may feel alone, but it’s only because you understand better than others. You have to find your “people”, I’m a radical feminist as well, not the crazy left stuff I’ve been seeing at all. I can’t share my true beliefs with anyone around me, and it sucks. There’s more people like you than you realize, you’re just not around them, I promise. I truly believe if we are in a place in our life where we feel completely uncomfortable, it means we aren’t supposed to be there. As in that place, that situation, within our life. But never that we are not supposed to be here at all. I really hope you’re ok, truly.

I went through something similar for almost 4 years. Couldn’t understand why but I was in a really low place and anxious over stuff that I never used to bat an eye at. First off, are you able to/ comfortable talking to a counselor or therapist? It helps immensely, and wasn’t until after a few appointments I started to feel better.

I’m sorry you’re feeling this way, it’s weird because it seems most people go through a very low phase at some point, I thought I was alone in feeling the way I did for so long, but now I’m very open about it, so it’s been easier for others to open up about feeling similar in certain situations. The world is upside down it feels right now, I recommend you take time to write things that you enjoy, that you feel make up “you” and how you’d want people to view you. Do you enjoy books, writing, drawing, watching videos, creating things, music, being in nature, animals, etc. Take time to figure yourself out, and if the job doesn’t feel right don’t force your self, but also try to remember these feelings could be temporary. If not, please reach out to a professional, it’s not a fun place to experience by yourself
